title: Indian-Style Toasted Sandwich
description: A simple and flavorful sandwich recipe with Indian-inspired flavors. Serve as a snack or light meal.
instructions: 1. Toast the rye bread slice until lightly browned.
2. Spread 1 tablespoon of chutney on each toasted bread slice.
3. Place 1 slice of American cheese between the two bread slices.
4. Grill or toast the sandwich until the cheese is melted and the bread is crispy.
5. Cut the sandwich in half and serve immediately.
